verdict.rationale: The product ships its own standard-library Python scripts that need no network. One is invoked from the command line (`python3 replica-design/contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json`), and the sweep step reportedly blocks the deploy until the code is clean, so parts of it can run non-interactively as automation gates. However, the main workflow is a set of skills run interactively inside Claude Code or a chat, and nothing documents headless or CI execution of the skills themselves. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive mode for the skills, CI integration guidance or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), exit-code/gating semantics for the scripts, independent corroboration.
